role: Separate post hoc scoring diagnostic; never changes stock qualification or search
models: Version-pinned default ensemble; no model selection using evaluation labels
primary: Compare original Vina score to CNNaffinity on the identical Vina-selected top pose of the identical Vina-selected best supplied state
secondary: CNNscore on that same fixed pose
Maximum CNNaffinity over the same complete stock pose pool and supplied states; this also changes pose selection
datasets: Frozen five-target published-protocol campaign as complete compound states become available

metrics.auc: Higher CNN outputs are better; lower original Vina score is better

integrity: Hash source poses and receptors; require one output per input pose and one-to-one heavy-atom coordinate agreement within 0.002 A without alignment; all required states must succeed
input_packaging: GNINA native PDBQT requires separate pose files without MODEL/ENDMDL wrappers or empty/NUL-only padding lines. Preserve all atom records and archived original files; native PDBQT output avoids the observed SDF conversion crash.
cost: Per-state subprocess wall time includes WSL launch, model loading, scoring all saved poses and output; report per complete compound and per pose. Record GPU utilization, total device memory, process CPU time and peak RSS where available. These are not isolated kernel timings.
interpretation: An improvement on fixed poses supports a scoring contribution, not proof that pose generation is adequate. No improvement does not prove search is the cause. Training overlap and retrospective DUD-E bias limit causal and prospective claims. Failed baseline targets remain failed.
execution: Wait for CPU throughput sweep to finish before GPU scoring
